title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 7a. Stresses that education represents the starting point for cultivating principles and values that contribute to the personal development of children, as well as to social cohesion and democracy, and the rule of law around the world; to that end calls for the EU to promote its values by supporting access to education and learning for women and girls;
